listing.name: Suitable Star Systems
listing.summary: A mod for starsector that adds star systems to different constellations near the core worlds, star systems are overpowered and is meant to speed up colony phase or midgame/endgame.
listing.aiSummary: Adds three procedural star systems near the core worlds for colonization, remnant fleet farming, and omega fleet spawning.

description:
Suitable Star Systems 2.4.4d

Compatibility:

Only works on new saves

Not safe to remove from an ongoing campaign

Not save compatible for versions below 2.4.0a

Integrations:

LunaLib - Has native support for mod settings

A mod that I privately use for my Starsector campaigns.

The mod adds three star systems to different constellations near the core worlds.

The colonizable star system is overpowered and are meant to speed up the colony phase.

The other star systems are places you can farm alpha cores and [SUPER REDACTED] weapons.

The location and the star system names are procedural so you still need to explore.

The first system contains the planets to colonize as well as all unique entities.

The second system contains a planet that spawns remnant fleets.

The third system contains a planet that spawns omega fleets.

PreviewsClick the image to enlarge

[close]SecretsFor the omega system, you need the planet killer and then use it on the planet to make omega fleets start spawning.

(The mini-quest can be overridden in the settings.json file found in the modname/data/config. So you don't need the planet killer and the omega fleets will immediately spawn. Can be enabled and disabled any time)

[close]Settings- If you have lunalib, settings options are in the mod settings

- If you don't have lunalib, settings options are in the settings.json file in "thismodname/data/config/..."

[close]

If you need help or want to send feedback, you can make a post on this thread.

If you want to support me, you can do so through my Patreon page.

Credits

Wispborne

- for the starsector intellij mod template and the github action script.

starsector community

- for many resources in regard to modding and spriting.

Alex and Co

- for making a great game and community.

aiDescription: Introduces three new star systems located in constellations near the core worlds. One system is designed for rapid colonization, while the others provide resources like alpha cores and specific weapons. The systems are procedurally placed to require exploration, with one spawning remnant fleets and another spawning omega fleets after a specific condition is met.
